candidates.note: OPi5+ DTB is built against Rockchip 5.10 BSP header; CRU must register outputs at BSP indices or every consumer resolves the wrong clock. Vendored bsp-opi5plus reference tree as the id-domain truth source.
x-kernel has no runtime PM; gate-link semantics approximated by holding the linked interconnect clock prepared+enabled for the controller lifetime (boot-static).

Each PLL exports TWO clocks (pll_x node + mode mux). The mode mux needs SET_RATE_PARENT|NO_REPARENT: without NO_REPARENT the kclk mux laterally re-parents in determine_rate and the PLL is never reprogrammed.
Assigned rates equal to bootloader-programmed values must short-circuit (no mux dance/PLL power cycle on live hardware); mirrors clk_core_set_rate_nolock early return.
